name: Notepad Markdown Browse Mode
author: abdel792
description: An NVDA screen reader add-on providing virtual buffer support and quick navigation for Markdown documents in Microsoft Notepad (IAccessible and UIA). Features: Quick navigation: H / Shift+H: Headings (levels 1 to 6) K / Shift+K: Links Q / Shift+Q: Block quotes L / Shift+L: Lists I / Shift+I: List items Elements List dialog (NVDA+F7) to inspect and jump to structural elements.
